name: professional distance
source:
Mira, a young historian, travels to a small museum of technology to study her idol's magnum opus: a robot that can feel like a person. In the final days of her visit, she learns something that turns her research on its head — and brings her closer to the robot than she ever thought she'd go.

[From [url=https://mousemousemoose.itch.io/professional-distance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
米拉是一位年轻的历史学家，她前往一家小型科技博物馆研究她偶像的代表作：一个可以感觉像人的机器人。在访问的最后几天，她学到了一些东西，使她的研究发生了翻天覆地的变化，并使她比她想象的更接近机器人。

[来自[url=https://mousemousemoose.itch.io/professional-distance]Itch.io[/url]]
